_note: THE IMAGE-PAD BOUNDARY — the most consequential instrument correction since the white canvas. The wave-25 calibration proved the ref canvas contract itself was broken: :where(body){padding:16px} cannot move position:absolute overlays in REF pages (body is not a containing block), so every ref using abs-positioned expected-result bars was INTERNALLY misaligned by (-16,-16) — and painting correctly was PENALIZED (92-100% of every css-gaps mismatch was this artifact; iOS/Android lost score BY implementing the feature). The new contract: refs render UNPADDED at 358x568 (the old content box — wrap points byte-stable, display:flow-root replacing the padding load-bearing collapse block) and the 16px frame is added in IMAGE space (pngjs, border-ring-sampled pad color), translating in-flow and out-of-flow ref content identically. CANVAS_REV: white-black-ink-font-lh-imgpad. The out-of-flow contract migrated on ALL THREE platforms (hoist anchors at the padded origin via one shared frame constant + ICB extents 358x568; web gained a dedicated data-capture-icb div; both bake paths aligned to the ref viewport with a SHARED canvasFrameCss factory so the three injection sites cannot drift again) — css-position 7/7 HELD through the migration. SCORING HONESTY: colorDivergent now hard-fails WITH a CIEDE2000 >= 2.3 second opinion (the bare stamp would have failed pixel-exact renders — histogramKL fabricates it on near-uniform images), and the absolute low-content bypass became a symmetric coverage-RATIO gate (max/min > 2). 57 predicted flips landed, 0 true passes lost: css-text boundary-shaping x8 (tiny-ink dishonest passes), css-backgrounds animation family, multicol color divergences, transforms 3d-context. THE FEATURES: css-gaps recovered to web 12/12 / natives 11/12 (from 2-6/12 — the wave-24 painters were RIGHT; the ref was wrong; plus Compose FlowRow main-axis gap [a general wrapping-flex defect], shrink-0 overflow, cross-axis stretch hard-constraints on both natives, iOS painter surface union-bbox); css-values 11/12 everywhere (the ATTR BAKE — typed attr() resolved at extract time, the fourth bake); css-lists 11/10/10 (marker child-props + shorthand honesty); UA block margins extended to block DESCENDANTS on both natives; post-load bake grew border-radius + list-style longhands. Totals: web 202/233, iOS 188/233, Android 183/233 — DOWN ~5 per platform in exchange for the honest contract; six sections perfect on all three (position 7/7, sizing, flexbox, display, grid, ui). Zero regressions in the 327 dark stage.
